subject: Vendor metadata canonicalization + MSA redlines impacting portal onboarding
messages:
From: Samantha Lin <sam.lin@medsyscorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcurementOps <procurement@medsyscorp.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor metadata canonicalization and outstanding MSA redlines

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We started attempting vendor registration in Ariba and ran into two blockers that seem tied to the MSA redlines your team circulated:

1) Our portal rejects vendor records when the "Legal Entity Short Name" field exceeds 35 characters and your proposed order form references the full entity legal name in that field.
2) PO acknowledgement (406 ACK) window: Ariba's default is 24 hours, but your Order Form language currently uses "reasonable time" which our procurement ops team flagged as non-compliant with our supplier SLA.

Can you share a concise list of the fields you expect Redwood to populate during portal onboarding (Ariba/Coupa) and confirm what you can commit to for PO ACK turnaround? We are trying to get this into our provisioning playbook so our vendors don't get blocked.

Also attaching the redlined MSA we received from our legal team (attached). Please let us know if the short-name vs. full-name requirement is negotiable, or whether we should map to a separate "display name" field.

Appreciate it — Sam

Attachments: MedSys_MSA_Redline.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <sam.lin@medsyscorp.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor metadata canonicalization and outstanding MSA redlines

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers up-front, then proposed next steps: 

- Portal field mapping: Redwood can provide both a "legal_name" and a separate "display_name" during provisioning. We will ensure the short-name (display_name) is <=35 characters to satisfy the portal constraint; legal_name will hold the full registered entity name for contract purposes.
- PO ACK SLA: We can set an operational target of 72 hours for automated acknowledgement from our vendor-facing system; however, we understand MedSys requires 24 hours per policy. I will escalate to ops and propose an exception if we can commit to 48 hours within a dedicated onboarding window.

Next steps:
1) Internal sync (copying our integrations + legal): Soojin will validate the field map and any EDI/PO label transformations needed for Ariba vs. Coupa.
2) Legal redline review: Kimberly, can you highlight any MSA language that prevents us from committing to a PO ack window?
3) I'll prepare a concise matrix for your provisioning playbook (fields + example values + max length) and attach a first-pass portal_field_map_v1.xlsx.

I'll follow up by EOD tomorrow with the matrix.

— Rafael

Attachment: portal_field_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor metadata canonicalization and outstanding MSA redlines

Folks — quick technical read:

- Ariba vs. Coupa field differences: Ariba expects an explicit "shortName" field and will truncate silently if longer than allowed; Coupa uses "display_name" (user-visible) and accepts a larger legal_name blob. We'll surface both fields in our onboarding payload and add a validation step that rejects candidate vendor entries exceeding portal limits so they fail fast in our staging environment.
- EDI PO ACK mapping: The Ack window is a business SLA, not an EDI technical constraint. From our side we can surface an "ACK_TIMEOUT_DAYS" parameter per vendor record (default 3 = 72 hours). If MedSys requires 1 day, we need a signed operational exception in the Order Form or a carve-out in the onboarding checklist where the vendor confirms acceptance of the shorter SLA.

Proposed action items for Redwood:
- Create portal_field_map_v1.xlsx (Rafael done) with: legal_name, display_name/shortName, tax_id, remit_address_block, invoice_contact_email, ack_timeout_days, vendor_classification_code.
- Add validation rule: display_name length <=35 enforced pre-provisioning (option to auto-truncate + suffix numeric token).

Kimberly — looping you to confirm whether the vendor-level ACK SLA needs to be expressed in the MSA, the Order Form, or if it can be a separate operational attachment to the Order Form.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <sam.lin@medsyscorp.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor metadata canonicalization and outstanding MSA redlines

Hi Sam / team — legal review complete on the two points you raised. Summary below and proposed redline language to resolve the onboarding gap: 

1) Short name vs. legal name: Agree with provision of both fields. Proposed Order Form clause: "Supplier will provide both a Legal Entity Name (no character limit) and a Display Name (max 35 characters) for use in procurement portal UIs; where a portal requires a truncated value, Supplier will provide the truncated Display Name as a separate data element."

2) PO acknowledgement SLA: Because MedSys' procurement policy requires 24-hour ACKs, we cannot unilaterally change contract language in the MSA to guarantee a 24-hour SLA for all vendors. Proposed pragmatic approach: add an Order Form appendix "Vendor Operational Commitments" where Ack Timeout (in hours) can be specified per-engagement. For onboarding, Redwood will commit to a default 72-hour ACK_TIMEOUT unless the parties sign the appendix specifying 24 hours. That appendix can be attached as an operational exhibit and does not alter core indemnity/liability provisions.

Please confirm if MedSys is willing to accept the appendix model. If yes, Raphael/So ojin — we should: 1) update the Order Form template with the appendix placeholder, 2) add the ack_timeout_days field to portal_field_map_v1.xlsx, and 3) create an onboarding checklist that flags vendors needing a 24-hour exception so Legal/Procurement can sign the appendix.

Sam — if that sounds acceptable, I can produce a one-page appendix template and Kimberly will circulate a DocuSign envelope to MedSys legal for signature.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
